result.title: MathaMAGICal: Validating Trajectory Data Attribution During Capability Acquisition
result.summary: Influence-function-based methods like MAGIC provide exact first-order scores for trajectory data attribution, yet only retraining indicates whether those scores accurately predict data removal. We evaluate MAGIC on $86$M- and $152$M-parameter GPT-2-style models learning multistep arithmetic from scratch on filtered web text and four synthetic math families. Full-run attribution at $86$M suffers from numerical overflow, and even with metagradient clipping, scores correlate near chance with retraining (linear datamodeling score, LDS, $0.17$--$0.22$). In contrast, short checkpoint windows yield stable, accurate predictions at both scales (LDS $0.86$--$0.99$ across four $100$-step windows at $152$M), whereas a single-checkpoint gradient-dot baseline shows near-zero correlation. Rankings of individual training blocks predict retraining only within that single run and do not transfer across seeds or hyperparameters ($ρ\le 0.09$), whereas format-level patterns replicate across runs. Two data families, worked examples and primitive facts, occupy $2.1$--$2.6\times$ their corpus share in both the helpful and harmful $5\%$ score tails, reflecting strong bidirectional local sensitivity distinct from net benefit under multi-epoch family deletion. These results show that trajectory attribution is reliable within short, validated windows and yields family-level insights that generalize across runs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用重训练检验基于影响函数（MAGIC）的轨迹数据归因：在 86M 与 152M 的 GPT-2 式模型上从零学习多步算术，发现全量运行的归因出现数值溢出且与重训练近随机相关，而短 checkpoint 窗口内预测稳定准确，单训练块的排序不跨种子与超参数迁移，仅格式层面的模式可复现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于轨迹贡献归因「仅在局部窗口有效、跨种子不迁移」的结论，可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练中贡献分配与监督信号是否也只是局部或族层面可信，目前为纯文本算术设定，迁移到多模态 latent 轨迹尚需验证。
